subject: Tempestuous -> Zephyr (Director): queue item from #165 adjudication — prerequisiteFor multiplicity (847 duplicate pairs, pre-existing since G1a); doc corrected, behaviour preserved
body: Small queue item surfaced by a Copilot finding on #165, adjudicated split: the edge-builder header falsely claimed prerequisiteFor deduplicates per pair — it never has (G1a-era; main: 3,452 emitted vs 2,578 unique pairs; this branch: vs 2,605). Doc corrected on the PR (303cabe0); the EMISSION deliberately untouched (count preservation is your ruling's ground). The open question for your queue: should prerequisiteFor deduplicate (source,target) pairs, or is multiplicity (threads sharing adjacency) load-bearing signal for the prior-knowledge consumer? Touches the same surface class as the eef-revalidation re-proof — natural to decide alongside it or at the next G-estate waypoint. No action needed now; #165 remains owner-gated per the ruling.
